steps.en: Notices due at the third reminder stage are picked for the letter
steps.id: Notice yang jatuh tempo di stage reminder ketiga dipilih untuk surat
steps.why_en: Daily letter run is switched off in code; letters only go out when triggered by hand
steps.why_id: Job surat harian dimatikan di code; surat hanya keluar kalau dipicu manual

steps.en: The letter uses the owner's updated name and address
steps.id: Surat memakai nama dan alamat pemilik yang diperbarui
steps.why_en: An older marked address can still be used, and the company refresh is off in production.
steps.why_id: Alamat lama yang sudah ditandai masih bisa dipakai, dan pembaruan company mati di production.

steps.en: A data file with the letter details is built for the vendor
steps.id: File data berisi detail surat dibuat untuk vendor

steps.en: The file is delivered to the vendor's secure file drop
steps.id: File dikirim ke tempat penerimaan file aman vendor
steps.why_en: Sending to the vendor is deliberately blocked by a setting in every environment.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman ke vendor sengaja diblokir lewat setting di semua environment.

steps.en: Notices move to the next stage once the letter is sent
steps.id: Notice pindah ke stage berikutnya setelah surat terkirim
steps.why_en: When sending is blocked the notices still move on as if the letter had gone out.
steps.why_id: Saat pengiriman diblokir, notice tetap maju seolah surat sudah keluar.
